items.title: Trane Technologies Raises Full-Year Forecast After Strong Second-Quarter Performance
items.summary: Trane Technologies plc (NYSE:TT) reported better-than-expected second-quarter earnings on Thursday and lifted its full-year guidance after continued demand for its energy-efficient climate solutions drove double-digit revenue growth. The stronger outlook was welcomed by investors, sending the company’s shares up 6.

items.title: Carrier Beat Estimates, Raised Its Outlook, And Fell Anyway
items.summary: The market looked past a small earnings beat to a profit that is still shrinking and a raised target that leans heavily on the back half of the year.

items.title: Trane Technologies’s (NYSE:TT) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue, Stock Soars
items.summary: HVAC company Trane (NYSE:TT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.6% year on year to $6.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.31 per share was 1.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
